ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: The figure shows the first three patterns of the sequence from left to right; each pattern is an outer frame composed of gray small squares, with a square hole in the middle. In the 1st pattern, the middle hole is 1×1; in the 2nd pattern, the middle hole is 2×2; in the 3rd pattern, the middle hole is 3×3. Counting the gray small squares by rows, the 1st, 2nd, and 3rd patterns respectively have 20, 28, and 36 gray small squares. Reasoning: The problem says these are the first three patterns of the sequence and asks for the 10th pattern. The numbers of gray small squares are 20, 28, 36 in order, increasing by 8 each time, so this is an arithmetic sequence. The 10th pattern has 9 more increments than the 1st pattern, so the number is 20 + 9×8 = 92.
